scope: Exactly frozen three-method comparison, absolute error1e-8 against independent scalar q32 midpoint quantile, no native-path certificate or originalBMchange

methods.actual_implementation: Local classical rational interval solver, sixteen certified floorwords; all-input mathematically defined floorlaw is separate from solver completeness
required_primitives: Exact comparison of CDF interval to q32 midpoint
Reversible bisection history and final f40 floorbin selection
methods.native_interface_gap: Audited C07 method uses224-bit outward endpoints and1760-bit work precision; this is not a72-bit/f40 arithmetic leaf. No certified finite CDF comparison leaf or bounded all-input decision proof exists.
methods.why_no_quantum_cost: 704 classical bisections/736 CDF calls and51.6875 CPU seconds over16 words do not specify native gates, coherent branches, comparison storage or cleanup. No quantumcost extrapolation.
methods.smallest_missing_certificate: A globally defined bounded interval-comparison/fallback contract for all q32 words, before any native CDF interval leaf; no additional word tests are proposed

methods.exact_q32_tail_domain: u_min=min(u,1-u)>=2^-33; r=sqrt(-log(u_min)); ordinary tail uses r-8/5 and degree7 numerator/denominator
methods.extreme_tail_exclusion_proof: -log(u_min)<=33*log(2)<33*(3/4)=99/4<25, because exp(3/4)>1+3/4+(3/4)^2/2=65/32>2. Thus r<5. This exact-domain observation is not an approximate native branch certificate.

structural_scalar_arithmetic_only.central: Two degree7 Horner polynomials, fourteen polynomial multiplies/adds; q-square and q-times-numerator plus one variable division; sign, constants and exact branch controls additional
structural_scalar_arithmetic_only.ordinary_tail: One log, one square root, two degree7 Horner polynomials and one variable division; symmetry/sign and exact branch controls additional

required_primitives: Exact rational-domain predicate from q32 rawword
Native log and square root on proved positive input ranges
Signed output restoration and clean XOR/cleanup
methods.existing_reversible_support: Graph and primitives already expose add/sub/mul/cmul/lt/select/divide/sqrt/msb/shift/lookup. Graph.log is a coefficient-lookup/multiply macro. Existing divide is unsigned; negative rational numerators require magnitude and sign restoration.
methods.denominator_contract: Central exact r>=0 and displayed positive denominator coefficients with constant1 imply denominator>=1 in real arithmetic. A native coefficient/rounding/nooverflow bound and ordinary-tail transformed-argument range still need proof; the graph max(denominator,raw1) clamp cannot silently change the approximant.
uncertified_terms: AS241 real rational approximation residual on complete q32 domain
Coefficient serialization and f40 Horner rounding
Native log/sqrt error in ordinary tail
Positive denominator, no wraparound and exact branch agreement
methods.smallest_missing_certificate: Freeze the unmodified AS241 central coefficient lists and prove its positive-magnitude rational evaluation contract on u in[3/40,37/40], including f40 rounding/nooverflow and denominator bounds. This smaller branch needs no log or sqrt; it is not a full-domain quantile certificate.
